evidence: Modifies src/node/blockstorage.cpp and .h to rewrite and manage XOR obfuscation keys across block and undo files.
rationale: Provides a crash-safe mechanism for node operators to obfuscate or deobfuscate pre-v28 block files without redownloading the entire chain. While solving a real operator inconvenience (re-syncing hundreds of gigabytes), block obfuscation is a local defense against external AV scanners rather than a core consensus or chainstate integrity requirement.
